title: Complete Overall Git History & Codebase Memory Audit
description: Comprehensive master memory of all fixes, features, and refactorings across the entire InnoVTSM66 Git repository history.
content:
# Complete Master Memory Audit: InnoVTSM66 Firmware Project

## 1. History Transmission & Packet Processing Fixes (Commit 2026-08-19)
- Fixed ProcessHistoryPacket() in custom/Server.c to accept PROTO_OG packet headers (, , , , , , ).
- Resolved bug where saved history packets (< 150 bytes) were wrongly deleted from flash without being sent to server.

## 2. Reset Command () Execution Fix (Commit 2026-08-19)
- Fixed deferred reset AIS140ResetPending = 2 handling in custom/Server.c and custom/SMS.c.
- Added fallback execution if socket drops/times out during ,12 reply so command ,549211,,SET,018:1*69 always resets device cleanly.

## 3. Server OTA & Socket Handle Leak Fix (Commit 2026-08-19)
- Added explicit pre-creation socket cleanup in custom/TCP.c (if (socket->SocketIndex >= 0) Ql_SOC_Close(...)) before Ql_SOC_Create().
- Resolved 'Socket 0 create failed' handle leak error cycle.

## 4. 16MB Flash Migration & Footprint Optimization (Commit 4e319dca)
- FLASH_STORAGE_16MB macro in custom/config/custom_feature_def.h.
- Disables UFS history backup files and debug trace logs while keeping RS232 100% active.
- Reduces ROM image size from 342 KB to 187 KB (APPGS3MDM32A01.bin).
- Dynamic UFS percentage via Ql_FS_GetTotalSpace().
- Nuvoton M031 MCU SPI flash base address FW_FLASH_ADDR_BASE set to 0x1F0000 for 2MB W25Q16 chip.

## 5. FTP/FOTA Storage Cleanup System (Commit 65cb8c40 & 5249dea3)
- Sweeps BK_*.bin history, BkCount.bin, batch files, and FOTA_*.bin prior to firmware download in custom/FTP.c.
- Added progress logging (ClearHistoryStorage: sweeping 1..256) to prevent thread stalls.

## 6. Nuvoton M031 MCU Co-Processor (Commit 4e319dca)
- QuectelM031-main/ firmware for dual-chip architecture: Quectel M66 handles cellular/GPS, Nuvoton M031 handles LSM6DSOX accelerometer, vehicle IOs, and MCU MOTA protocol.

## 7. AIS-140 AMD3 Protocol Engine (Commit 4e319dca)
- Supports 23 standard commands with Layer 1 (IMEI), Layer 2 (Password), Layer 3 (XOR checksum) verification in ParseStandardAIS140Command().
- Sends dedicated ,12 response frames or embeds responses into  OTAResp fields.

## 8. Sensors Subsystem (Commit a2921bef)
- custom/Sensors.c supports RFID tags, fuel sensors, temperature sensors, and BLE peripherals.

## 9. IMEI Handling & Network Refactoring (Commit 3ef86974)
- Fixed IMEI retrieval fallback and null pointer checks when SIM/Network initialization is pending.

## 10. Dual FOTA/MOTA Architecture (Commit 3b62ad46)
- OpenCPU GPRS FOTA via FTP and Nuvoton M031 MCU MOTA via OpenCPU UART/SPI bridge.

## 11. Multi-Layer System Recovery Watchdogs
- SystemRecovery.c 4-layer watchdog system (Main task, GPRS stall, Server connection, GPS fault state).
